speaker: consultant
text: Good afternoon, this is Elena Ward.

speaker: customer
text: Good afternoon. This is Robert Hayes. I am calling about my last card payment.

speaker: customer
text: I was charged twice for this month's retainer. Six hundred dollars, two times, on the same day.

speaker: consultant
text: That should not happen. Let me look at the payments.

speaker: customer
text: I have the bank statement here if you need the details.

speaker: consultant
text: Thank you, I can see it. There are two payments of six hundred dollars on the third. The payment link was processed twice.

speaker: consultant
text: I will refund the second payment today. It usually takes three to five business days to appear on your card.

speaker: customer
text: Okay. Will I get something in writing?

speaker: consultant
text: Yes. I will email you a refund confirmation within the hour, with the amount and the date.

speaker: customer
text: Good. And will this happen again next month?

speaker: consultant
text: No. I will send next month's invoice with a new payment link, and I will check the payment myself.

speaker: customer
text: Fine. That is all I need.

speaker: consultant
text: I am sorry for the trouble, Robert.

speaker: customer
text: These things happen. Thank you for sorting it out.

speaker: consultant
text: You're welcome. Have a good afternoon.
